name: vibe-sweeten-drum-glue
description: CLEAN sweeten/air + gentle harmonic 'glue' on a drum bus or loop from the UADx Vibe Analog Machines, using its DEFAULT machine SWEETEN at drive 50. SWEETEN is the gentlest, brightest voicing — measured on a 1 kHz tone it sits at ~0.8% THD (odd-harmonic, near-clean), and on the Watercolors drum loop (peak-normalized to -1 dBFS) it BRIGHTENS without crushing: spectral centroid 1593 -> 1725 Hz, +1.3-1.5 dB up at 5-10 kHz (air), tilt -2.71 -> -2.62 dB/oct, and crucially CREST HELD 14.63 -> 14.75 dB (transients intact — it adds top/sparkle like a clean exciter, it does NOT compress). The warble knob is left at 0 (no wow/flutter). This is the safe 'make it a touch more alive/present' default. Heavier color: raise param_1 (drive) toward 70-100, or switch the machine to WARM/GLOW (darker, more glue) or VINTAGIZE/SPUTTER/FIRE (lo-fi/distorted).
intended_for: a drum bus / loop you want subtly BRIGHTER + more present + lightly glued, with the color coming from gentle analog harmonics rather than EQ — the clean, transient-preserving end of the Vibe machine range
plugin_build: UADx 'uaudio_verve.vst3' — the binary's internal codename is 'verve' but it reports its product name as 'UADx Vibe Analog Machines'. The product is the renamed Verve Analog Machines (so reviews/manual say 'Verve'). UADx native build, RENDERS headless via Pedalboard (verified; iLok account, no dongle — authorized here). 6 params, all Pedalboard enums; the 'machine' string enum must go through this setattr harness (apply-vst-chain's float dict would miss it). NOTE the 'Essentials' build is uaudio_verve_essentials.vst3 (only the 4 tape machines THICKEN/VINTAGIZE/SWEETEN/WARM, drive only — no warble/output_trim).
notes: PARAM MAP (measured): param_1 = the DRIVE knob (0-100, default 40; the amount of the selected machine's saturation), param_2 = the WARBLE knob — SWEETEN is one of the 6 TAPE machines, so here param_2 is WARBLE (0-100, default 0; tape wow/flutter PITCH modulation, meter-invisible); on the 4 PREAMP machines (Edge/Glow/Distort/Sputter) this SAME slot is a TONE/brightness control instead. output_trim = the bipolar -/0/+ output slider (-12..+12 dB, perfectly linear clean gain), machine = the named voicing (the on-screen colour swatches), power/master_bypass = on/off.

DRIVE 0 IS NOT BYPASS. Even at param_1=0 the machine still colors (SWEETEN d0 on a tone = 0.24% THD, +level). For a true null use master_bypass=true (0.000% THD) or power=false. So compare against a real bypass render, not drive 0.

DRIVE IS NOT RELIABLY GAIN-COMPENSATED — the clippy machines lose peak as they saturate, so this harness peak-normalizes to -1 dBFS. A/B loudness-matched ([[level-match]] / render-ab) or 'warmer/brighter' may just be a level illusion.

SWEETEN drive sweep on the loop (peak-norm crest): d0 14.81 -> d40 14.88 -> d70 13.62 -> d100 11.05; centroid stays ~3.3k(python)/rises slightly, air climbs. So push drive for more sparkle+glue; back off to ~30-40 for a hair of life.

Verify with measure-spectrum + measure-loudness: expect centroid UP, a small +air lift at 5-10 kHz, tilt slightly flatter, crest roughly HELD. A 0.00 delta means the .component/AU twin loaded instead of uaudio_verve.vst3 (load==renders is NOT guaranteed for UAD twins — this uaudio_ build is the one that renders).
